# US Carnegie R1 AI Policy Audit 2026

> Open dataset: all 187 US Carnegie R1 research universities (2025 Carnegie
> Classification), audited for whether each publishes official AI usage
> guidance on its own domain.
> By Study Intelligence (https://aclas.si). License: CC-BY-4.0.
> Snapshot: 2026-10-17.

## What question does this answer?

Has each US R1 university published official AI usage guidance or policy?
Each YES was verified by opening the policy page on the university's own
official domain.

## Key findings

- 178 of 187 (95.2%) publish verifiable AI guidance.
- 1 confirmed NO: University of Wyoming.
- 8 UNCLEAR (could not verify, not proven absent): Brown, Clemson,
  UT Health San Antonio, UT Southwestern, UMass-Boston, Miami, UNH,
  Weill Cornell Medicine.
- The US research sector has standardized on governing AI, not banning it.

## Files

- `us-r1-ai-policy-audit-2026.csv` / `.json` — 187 rows, one per university
- `METHODOLOGY.md` — definitions, verification rules, caveats
- `AUDIT-LOG.md` — source list, corrections, least-sure rows
- `raw/` — 16 audited batch tables + 2 fix files (provenance)
- `parse.py` — exact script that generated CSV/JSON
- `CITATION.cff` — machine-readable citation

## Columns (CSV)

`id`, `university`, `official_domain`, `has_policy` (YES / NO / UNCLEAR),
`policy_url` (confirmed live 2026-10-17), `page_title`, `date_info`,
`scope` (students / faculty-teaching / all-community), `note`.

## Caveats

- ~30 rows are "soft YES" (guidance-level vs formal policy, crawl-only
  confirmation) — flagged in `AUDIT-LOG.md`.
- Snapshot 2026-10-17; policies change — verify before citing a row.

2026" (v1.0.0, 2026-10-17). CC-BY-4.0.
